CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS storeZones (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  storeId INT NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  code VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  surface INT,
  location TEXT,
  isSponsored BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('active', 'inactive', 'maintenance') DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zoneSponsors (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  zoneId INT NOT NULL,
  supplierName VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  supplierLogo TEXT,
  contractAmount INT NOT NULL,
  startDate TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  endDate TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('active', 'expired', 'cancelled') DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL,
  contactName VARCHAR(255),
  contactEmail VARCHAR(320),
  contactPhone VARCHAR(20),
  notes TEXT,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

ALTER TABLE planogramLocations ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS zoneId INT AFTER storeId;
